prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look (ignore its labels, they are not part of the picture). "Rennhalle 9", a huge old corrugated-metal race hall at the harbour of the underground city, interior seen from above, cut-away walls on the top edge only, the scuffed concrete floor fills most of the image. The large walkable area is the hall floor: dark oil-stained concrete with a painted oval race track (white and red kerb stripes, faded lane lines, black tyre skid marks) running around a central infield; the floor is open and uncluttered.
CENTER: the infield of the oval track, a big rectangular island walled by stacked old tyres and crash barriers, inside it scrap heaps, a broken scrap-robot chassis and oil drums.
LEFT of the infield, on the track: a chequered start/finish line painted across the lane, and just above it a small steel launch ramp for robot racers.
TOP LEFT, against the back wall: an old concert stage - the most eye-catching spot - a raised wooden stage completely draped with grey-blue tarpaulins tied down with ropes, dusty speaker stacks peeking out under the tarps, a faded band banner without letters (a stylised lightning-and-cable symbol) half hidden.
In front of the stage, lying diagonally on the floor: a long fallen rusted aluminium lighting truss (a lattice girder with broken stage lamps still attached), corroded, with a few dry flowers and a burnt-down candle at one end.
UPPER CENTER on the floor: a soft pale pool of daylight falling down from a glass skylight high above (only the light shape on the floor, the roof itself is not visible), dust motes in the beam.
TOP RIGHT: steep wooden-and-steel spectator bleachers (rows of benches rising toward the back wall), empty, with crumpled cups and flags.
RIGHT EDGE: a betting booth - a small wooden kiosk with a barred counter window, a chalkboard with only tally marks and numbers-free symbols, a red lamp; below it a three-step winners podium made of painted crates with a dented golden trophy-shaped lamp on top.
LEFT EDGE: the pit lane - a row of open garage bays with workbenches, tool walls, welding gear, spare wheels and half-assembled scrap-robot racers under work lamps.
BOTTOM corners: stacks of crates, pallets and oil drums. Thin cables and string lights along the walls, drawn thin so they don't hide the floor.
EXITS clearly readable at the image edges: BOTTOM edge center - a big corrugated rolling shutter door half raised, with the wet harbour pavement and cyan neon glow visible beyond it.
Time: night, the hall dim and moody, warm yellow work lamps in the pit lane, hot pink and cyan neon strips along the walls, a few red warning lights.
